result.title: Automated PD-L1 Tumor Proportion Scoring with Uncertainty-Guided Triage in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
result.comment: 55 pages (29-page main text with 5 figures and 3 tables, followed by 26 pages of supplementary material)
result.summary: Programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) tumor proportion score (TPS) informs immunotherapy selection in non-small cell lung cancer. Near the 1% and 50% cutoffs, the score should also indicate when closer review is warranted. We designed a three-stage framework to follow the sequence of TPS assessment. Stage 1 identifies tumor regions and excludes macrophage-rich patches. Stage 2, a dual-branch cell counting network (D2Count-Net), counts PD-L1-positive and PD-L1-negative tumor cells in these regions to calculate TPS. Stage 3, TPS-Guard, an uncertainty-guided triage mechanism, reports model uncertainty as the disagreement among independently trained models, refers the most uncertain slides, and flags scores near the 1% or 50% cutoff when model estimates disagree across that cutoff. Flags state the reason for referral or alert the pathologist to possible scoring errors on auto-reported slides. In a retrospective, single-center study, 154 whole-slide images were scored by three pathologists, and the model and each pathologist were compared in turn with the mean of the other two. On the 114 slides unseen in training, model mean absolute error (MAE) was 6.96 percentage points, within the range of the three pathologists (4.24 to 8.29), and model uncertainty correlated with absolute TPS error (Spearman rho = 0.77) and inter-pathologist disagreement (rho = 0.71). After referral of the 15% most uncertain slides, model and pathologist MAE both decreased. Applied without retraining to an external, publicly available dataset, TPS-Guard still directed review to higher-error cases, and referring more uncertain cases raised sensitivity at the 50% cutoff. TPS-Guard provides reasons for reviewing individual automated scores and identifies slides that also produce greater disagreement among pathologists. Prospective reader studies should assess TPS-Guard's effect on TPS reporting.

AI.brief_summary: 论文构建三阶段 PD-L1 肿瘤比例评分框架：先定位肿瘤区域并排除巨噬细胞富集区，再由双分支网络计数阳性/阴性肿瘤细胞得出 TPS，最后用多模型分歧量化的不确定性做分诊，把最不确定或跨越 1%/50% 阈值的切片转交人工复核。回顾性单中心 154 张全切片上，模型误差落在三位病理医师范围内，不确定性与 TPS 误差及医师间分歧相关。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 无直接关系，但其「不确定性触发转交人工」与阈值附近的推迟报出策略，以及用人类评分者分歧检验不确定性质量的做法，可能为 LVR 的停止/弃答决策与证据获取价值评估提供核查线索。
